    # Prioritize bins with higher remaining capacity (more room)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    total_capacity = np.sum(bins)
    num_bins = len(bins)
    target_load = total_capacity / num_bins
    # Estimate new load after adding item to each bin
    new_loads = bins + item
    # Calculate deviation from target load
    deviations = np.abs(new_loads - target_load)
    # Prioritize bins with smaller deviation (closer to target load)
    priorities = 1 / (deviations + 1e-9)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    used = bins - np.minimum(bins, item)
    avg_utilization = np.mean(used / bins)
    target_load = avg_utilization * bins
    deviation = np.abs(used - target_load)
    return 1 / (deviation + 1e-10)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    new_loads = bins + item
    utilization = np.minimum(new_loads, bins) / (bins + 1e-9)
    mean_utilization = np.mean(utilization)
    deviation_from_mean = (utilization - mean_utilization) ** 2
    # Sharper penalty for high deviation; higher priority for lower deviation
    priorities = 1 / (deviation_from_mean + 1e-9)
    return priorities

    # Normalize by capacity to get utilization ratio
    utilization = new_loads / (bins + 1e-9)
    # Penalize bins that are too full or too empty; favor moderate utilization
    deviation_from_mean = np.abs(utilization - np.mean(utilization))
    # Higher priority for bins with lower deviation (closer to average utilization)
    priorities = 1 / (deviation_from_mean + 1e-9)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    current_utilization = bins / (bins + 1e-9)
    # Estimate new utilization if item is added
    new_loads = bins + item
    new_utilization = np.minimum(new_loads, bins + 1e-9) / (bins + 1e-9)
    # Compute improvement in utilization
    improvement = new_utilization - current_utilization
    # Penalize bins that are already close to full capacity
    overflow_penalty = np.clip((bins + item - bins) / (bins + 1e-9), 0, 1)
    # Final priority is improvement adjusted by penalty
    priorities = improvement / (overflow_penalty + 1e-9)
    # Normalize and ensure positive values
    priorities = np.maximum(priorities, 0)
    return priorities + 1e-9
